name: BSP_RainEmitter_SpawnStep
evidence: Provisional hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall on descriptor+38h with (float delta, vec3* worldPosition, float* axis), RET 0Ch; sole caller 00865AB0. Gates on delta * DAT_00D04368 * (DAT_00F87470 * DAT_00D7A220) against 00BD2F10(), then refreshes game+19FCh and requires node+124h > 0.0 (world Y above zero) before 004845D0, 00867B10 and 008687C0. The rain reading rests on the "raindrop.tga" descriptor and the above-water test; 00BD2F10's range decides the direction of the gate, so the verb is provisional. docs/GAME_WORLD_OCEAN.md.
